title.narrative: Program to Support Global Export Services
Programa de Apoyo a los Servicios Globales de Exportacin

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a desarrollar el mercado de servicios globales de exportacin en Uruguay. Los objetivos especficos son (i) aumentar la Inversin Extranjera Directa dirigida al sector de servicios globales de exportacin; (ii) aumentar las exportaciones de servicios globales de exportacin; e (iii) incrementar el nivel de empleo en el sector de servicios globales de exportacin.

The overall objective of the program is to develop the market for global services exports in Uruguay. The specific objectives are (i) increase Foreign Direct Investment in the service sector led to global export, (ii) increase exports of global services exportations (iii) increase the level of employment in the global export of services.
